v2-12.candidate: May the Lord repay your work, and may your reward be full from the Lord, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to trust.”

v1-16.display:
But Ruth said,
“Do not oppose me by making me leave you or turn back from following you,
for wherever you go, I will go,
and wherever you lodge, I will lodge.
Your people are my people,
and your God my God.

v1-17.display:
Where you die, I will die,
and there I shall be buried.
May the Lord do these things to me,
and add these things,
for death shall part me and you.”
